description: Build the MCP project canonicalizer daemon (deferred April 21 work). Creates and maintains mcp_project_canonical and mcp_project_members tables. Groups MCPs by canonical project (npm package, github repo, pypi package) so a single project's npm publish + github source + pypi mirror are recognized as one canonical project, not three independent MCPs. Unlocks UI aggregation and supply-chain-fork visibility. Idempotent re-run.
constraints: Schema additions only - never alter existing tables
